DESCRIPTION
  Manage declarative database schemas.

USAGE
  supabase db schema declarative <subcommand> [flags]

FLAGS
  --no-cache           Disable catalog cache and force fresh shadow database setup.
  --strict-coverage    Fail when bundled pg-delta finds schema objects it cannot manage instead of leaving them unmanaged.

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                                                          Show help information
  --version, -v                                                       Show version information
  --wizard                                                            Start wizard mode for a command
  --completions <bash|zsh|fish|sh>                                    Print shell completion script (choices: bash, zsh, fish, sh)
  --log-level <all|trace|debug|info|warn|warning|error|fatal|none>    Sets the minimum log level (choices: all, trace, debug, info, warn, warning, error, fatal, none)
  --output-format choice                                              Output format: text (default), json, or stream-json (NDJSON) (choices: text, json, stream-json)
  --output, -o choice                                                 output format of status variables (choices: env, pretty, json, toml, yaml, table, csv)
  --profile string                                                    use a specific profile for connecting to Supabase API
  --debug                                                             output debug logs to stderr
  --workdir string                                                    path to a Supabase project directory
  --experimental                                                      enable experimental features
  --network-id string                                                 use the specified docker network instead of a generated one
  --yes                                                               answer yes to all prompts
  --dns-resolver choice                                               lookup domain names using the specified resolver (choices: native, https)
  --create-ticket                                                     create a support ticket for any CLI error
  --agent choice                                                      Override agent detection: yes, no, or auto (default auto) (choices: auto, yes, no)

SUBCOMMANDS
  sync        Generate a new migration from declarative schema
  generate    Generate declarative schema from a database

DESCRIPTION
  Exports a live database into the complete declarative schema tree. This replaces declarative files only; it does not create migration files or update migration history. Use --output-dir to stage an export without changing the configured declarative path. In non-interactive use, pass --local, --linked, or --db-url explicitly.

USAGE
  supabase db schema declarative generate [flags]

FLAGS
  --no-cache               Disable catalog cache and force fresh shadow database setup.
  --strict-coverage        Fail when bundled pg-delta finds schema objects it cannot manage instead of leaving them unmanaged.
  --overwrite              Overwrite declarative schema files without confirmation.
  --output-dir string      Write the generated declarative schema to this directory without changing the configured declarative schema path.
  --reset                  Reset local database before generating (local data will be lost).
  --schema, -s string      Comma separated list of schema to include.
  --db-url string          Generates declarative schema from the database specified by the connection string (must be percent-encoded).
  --linked                 Generates declarative schema from the linked project.
  --local                  Generates declarative schema from the local database.
  --password, -p string    Password to your remote Postgres database.

DESCRIPTION
  Compares the supabase/migrations baseline with the complete declarative schema tree and writes the difference as migration files. When a legacy export omits known implicit extensions, interactive sync can add declarations and re-plan before writing. Use --no-apply for non-interactive generation without changing the local database; --apply or global --yes applies locally and updates local migration history.

USAGE
  supabase db schema declarative sync [flags]

FLAGS
  --no-cache             Disable catalog cache and force fresh shadow database setup.
  --strict-coverage      Fail when bundled pg-delta finds schema objects it cannot manage instead of leaving them unmanaged.
  --schema, -s string    Comma separated list of schema to include.
  --file, -f string      Saves schema diff to a new migration file.
  --name string          Name for the generated migration file.
  --apply                Apply the generated migration to the local database without prompting.
  --no-apply             Generate the migration file without prompting or applying it to the local database.

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                                                          Show help information
